status: Common storage/read/UI and Naver mock-tested client. Automatic collection is not enabled.
storage: UPLOADS_DIR/_reports/ad-spend/current.json; private, atomic replacement, cross-process writer.lock, no Prisma migration
input: One UTF-8 JSON object on stdin. Never include API keys, tokens, passwords, raw response headers or errors.
rules: All identifiers are strings, including Daangn campaign IDs larger than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Naver accountId is API CUSTOMER_ID, not the account number shown elsewhere in the UI.
Configure only explicitly approved EVN campaigns, then mark the verified account connection. No production identifiers or credentials are supplied by this code.

Collect is a snapshot of all allowed campaigns for one provider/account/date range. Combine per-campaign Naver responses before ONE collect action. Never save separate campaign responses as full-account snapshots.
Each row is an explicit observation, including a provider-confirmed zero. Omitted rows are missing, never zero; previous amounts remain but totals become incomplete.
Unique key: provider, accountId, campaignId, date. Later attempts replace individual rows; same-timestamp identical retry is idempotent, conflicting/older attempts are rejected.

amount must be a nonnegative decimal string, up to 30 integer and 12 fraction digits. Do not convert monetary values through floating point. VAT is included, excluded or unknown; unknown/mixed bases never form a confirmed total.
Date range is inclusive KST, from 2026-09-11, no future date, at most 366 days per store action; Naver requests at most 92 days.
Configure merges scopes and never deletes omitted campaigns. Keep paused/deleted campaigns; explicit end dates must not hide observations already stored. start is immutable once configured.
After a writer crash, stop all writers and verify no active writer before manually removing writer.lock. Never automatically steal the lock.
The existing authenticated GET /api/external-dashboard returns aggregates only in adSpend, using the selected range. _reports files are not served through uploads.
Daily report sums may differ from provider period sums due to rounding; never adjust individual observed values to force agreement. No CPA/ROAS or inquiry attribution changes.

naver.client: lib/naver-ad-spend.ts; fixed GET https://api.searchad.naver.com/stats, single campaign id, timeIncrement=1, query excluded from HMAC signature, redirect rejected, 10s timeout, 1 MiB body limit
naver.response: Control tower verified root {summary,data,compTm,cycleBaseTm}; data dateStart/dateEnd for one KST day; salesAmt integer KRW including VAT. Node 24 JSON source reviver preserves int64; older runtimes reject unsafe numeric values.
naver.next: Control tower to confirm credential injection and producer schedule separately. No IAM/infra changes or auto collector included.

daangn.next: Control tower to normalize the downloaded daily report and verify exact account/campaign/date/cost fields and VAT before import. Server API contract and auth remain unconfirmed; no invented endpoint or scraper.
daangn.identifier: Keep the confirmed campaign ID as its original string; never parse as Number.
